_comment: Globnetics Conventional Commits & Issue Linking: Validates that all commits merging into the default branch adhere to Conventional Commits standards (feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, perf, test, ci, build, revert) and optionally link an issue key. Powers automated semantic versioning and changelog generation.
name: Globnetics - Conventional Commits & Traceability

parameters.name: Conventional Commits with optional Ticket Prefix (e.g. feat(auth): GLOB-123 add SSO)
